operator_assessment.operator_summary: This export reflects a targeted recovery: the previously accepted Kongsberg U9 coupled repair (rvv-0184<->rvv-0145) was reverted because it caused material U11 regressions (Frisk Asker 3, Jar Bla additional <7-day gaps; Ringerike 2 worsened participation shortfall). The valid rvv-0156 restoration (2027-02-21, Tonsberghallen) was re-applied and is now protected. A bounded repair search for the Kongsberg U9 temporal_clustering finding found no safe, consequence-acceptable alternative: the only operationally-acceptable, non-dominated candidate (swapping rvv-0147/rvv-0185) does not touch any of the three clustered U9 tournaments and leaves the U9 min gap at 1 day, unchanged. The two candidates that do improve the U9 focus-team gap (1 -> 7 days) both fail consequence acceptability for retained U11/U12 teams even after #404 same-club sibling rotation was attempted, which found no acceptable substitution. The schedule is therefore intentionally left on the valid protected baseline (Kongsberg U9: Feb 20 / Feb 21 / Feb 28) rather than forcing a regression elsewhere. All other REVIEW_REQUIRED reasons (hosting-balance imbalances, participation shortfalls/deviations, one movable-ice host-confirmation item, two external-calendar conflicts) are pre-existing, unrelated to this change, and unchanged by it.

key_tradeoffs.title: Kongsberg U9 temporal clustering left unresolved
key_tradeoffs.summary: Three Kongsberg U9 tournaments remain within an 8-day window (Feb 20/21/28, min gap 1 day) because every legal placement exchange that would widen this gap creates a material <7-day gap for at least one other retained team (Tonsberg Gra, Jar Hvit, Ringerike 2, or Frisk Asker 2/3/Jar Bla), and bounded same-club sibling rotation (#404) could not find an acceptable substitute for any of them.

key_tradeoffs.title: Reverted the prior Kongsberg repair
key_tradeoffs.summary: The previously canonical rvv-0184<->rvv-0145 exchange (with Ringerike 2 -> Frisk Asker 1 roster substitution) was undone because #402 now evaluates its full consequence set and rejects it; Ringerike 2 and Frisk Asker 1's schedules are back to their pre-repair state.

remaining_actions.title: Kongsberg U9 spacing still needs attention
remaining_actions.summary: No automatic repair is currently safe; RVV/the operator may accept the current 1-day minimum gap as a strong-goal deviation (season accept-deviation) or wait for a future schedule change that opens a legal slot.

remaining_actions.title: Pre-existing season-wide findings unchanged
remaining_actions.summary: Hosting-balance imbalances, participation shortfalls/deviations, one movable host-confirmation opportunity (rvv-0053, Kongsberg) and two external-calendar conflicts remain from before this change and are unrelated to it.

limitations: The harness did not re-run a full season-wide semantic audit of every checklist item; it verified deterministic hard verification (ok, zero violations), confirmed no new operational-acceptability regressions from this specific recovery, and spot-checked Kongsberg-specific evidence, relying on repository-owned findings/consequence evidence for everything else.

checklist_findings.question: Ser harnesset andre materielle problemer eller manglende regler vi ikke allerede har tenkt på?
checklist_findings.finding: Deterministic verify: ok=true, zero hard violations, zero unresolved hosting obligations. The Kongsberg U9 temporal_clustering finding (temporal_clustering:Kongsberg:Kongsberg:U9) remains open: bounded search across the full declared dimension set (date, participants) is exhausted (search_coverage.untried=[]), with 131 rejected candidates and 2 consequence-rejected candidates (including a materially-improving one whose #404 sibling-substitution attempt found no acceptable substitute). This is bounded_search_exhausted, not proven_infeasible, and should not be summarized as unsolvable. Pre-existing season-wide REVIEW_REQUIRED reasons (hosting_balance_imbalances=12, external_calendar_conflicts=2, movable_host_confirmation_required=1, participation_shortfalls=100, participation_target_deviation=23, tournament_placement_shortfall=12) are unrelated to this change and were already present before it.
